items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Congo and all that kind of stuff too.

ctx.x: Not so much progressive. Bossanova. Oh yeah, Bossanova and Rumba, Sambos, Congo and all that kind of stuff too. But as far as I mean you have to play rock and roll, what do they call it again? Well they've got the twist for a while.
Not with the beat outfit in it.
